name: Base Trader Full Audit
description: Full codebase review of the Base Trader application. Identify all critical bugs, nonce handling issues, Telegram routing bugs, error propagation failures, and structural problems. Output a prioritized findings report.

systemOverview.what: Live trading system on Base mainnet. Buys tokens via Aerodrome DEX (WETH → token) when smart money signals pass threshold. Monitors and exits positions automatically.
pipeline: 1. Scanner fetches top smart-money tokens from Nansen API (holders_count, netflow, trader_count)
2. For each token: score_signal() computes total_score (max 400). Threshold: 175 to pass.
3. Passed signals: format_decision() sizes position at 20% of wallet balance (USD), capped at 1% of pool TVL
6. Telegram BUY alert sent to group -5264050975
7. Exit monitor runs periodically: exits on stop loss (support × 0.95), target hit, or SM netflow turns negative

keyParameters.positionSizing: min(20% wallet balance USD, 1% pool TVL USD)
keyParameters.wallet: BASE_WALLET_ADDRESS env var, WETH token balance used for trades

criticalBehaviors: execute.py: nonce must account for pending mempool txs to avoid replacement/underpriced errors
execute.py: approve and swap must use sequential nonces (approve first, swap next)
execute.py: failed swaps must return status=failed with error message, never silently succeed
execute.py: gas bump retry on replacement transaction underpriced
run_pipeline.py: BUY alert amount must reflect actual trade size (20% wallet), not a hardcoded placeholder
run_pipeline.py: all Telegram alerts must route to group -5264050975, not personal chat 374999219
positions.json must match on-chain state at all times
exit_monitor.py: stop loss and target exits must fire correctly
